The '''ComfortRide passenger airspeeder''' was a model of air vehicle used to transport people on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:The_posse_escapes.png|thumb|left|250px|Cad Bane's posse escapes from the Senate Building in ComfortRide speeders]]
The ComfortRide was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] similar in appearance to the [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|EasyRide]] model, but about two meters longer at 10,55 m.<ref name="TCW:IV" />

The airspeeder lacked the EasyRide's antenna, but had an elongated rear and a tail-fin.<ref name="HC" />

==History==
The ComfortRide was one of many models of taxi airspeeders in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and her entourage used a ComfortRide speeder to travel during their stay on Coruscant. The speeder was sabotaged and crashed into a skyscraper.<ref name="DOM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

Two ComfortRides were used during the rescue of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].<ref name="HC" />
